hold_text: manager merges; adds a read-only mode to the live-credentialed prop terminal probe surface (runs via breakout-login-check on the live VM)
why: PROP-ETH-DOM, pipeline PI-20260929-AQRK6CL1-0014. Live run #14457 (code bd340d6ae) resolved the watchlist panel but found n_candidate_inputs 0 for BTCUSD/ADAUSD/AVAXUSD/XRPUSD, so the search control's location is UNMEASURED. Adds apply=instrument-search-dump: a READ-ONLY dump of every visible input/combobox/searchbox/textbox/contenteditable/search-like button (attributes + ancestor chain, nearest the watchlist first). Never reads a value, never types, clicks, focuses or tags; skips anything inside a BUY+SELL container. Reuses the feed's saved session under the shared login.lock (no credential login); the instrument_search_dump mode never touches the executor's error counter or AUTO-REVERT latch. No sizing, guard, risk or config change; nothing joins executor.enabled_venue_symbols.
